checks: Nonzero exposed-only query with zero complement gives the same answer and retains every residual.
After a nonzero residual observation the updated matrices retain their original labels and have the product Haar law, including dimension one.
A planar quarter-turn distinguishes the true inverse-frame update from a missing transpose.
The posterior at every finite time and the equality of signed transcript laws hold for policies whose consecutive dimension profiles agree almost everywhere.
A two-block 3D policy uses the first observation to choose an inverse query on the other block or fixed padding.

open_work: Represent each deterministic capped primitive algorithm by such a policy, prove its history-measurable frames and profile compatibility recursively, and identify its actual padded transcript. Full Lemmas B.3 and B.4, the two main lower bounds and canonical admission remain open.
